description: NOAA's inundation-mapping repository provides a geospatial pipeline for producing flood extents from river-flow information and terrain. It constructs height-above-drainage products, catchment grids and synthetic rating curves, and includes map evaluation and calibration routines. Inputs include elevation, hydrographic networks, catchment definitions and flow estimates; outputs are flood-inundation maps and intermediate hydraulic-geospatial products. Geographic coverage centres on United States watershed processing, with configuration at hydrologic-unit scale. Public source is free under Apache-2.0. A limitation is that the documented example input collection contains nonpublic material and requires separate AWS credentials; the full workflow also has substantial storage requirements. Code availability does not establish unrestricted access to every demonstration input. The pipeline can convert National Water Model flows into infrastructure flood-exposure simulation inputs, related to model-noaa-national-water-model. The README explains Linux/container setup and execution. No restricted input store, container image or raster collection was accessed.
